answer: Age-Graded Attention Ledger. Each identity earns standing only by spending bounded daily attention: verified interactions that decay if unused. Standing gates access to high-value tasks, so a sybil must operate every identity continuously across the orchard of agents, forgoing the payoff of concentrating its own attention on one. New identities start on a low ledge, unable to reach rewards until months of sustained activity accrue. The garden of genuine participants compounds standing by depth, not count. Attacker cost: parallel labor and forgone income, scalable only linearly.
